iconography.realia_identification: Circular Bronze Age shield with 7 peripheral/central boss studs
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Round Shield.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/ka/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 12 (Round Shield) depicts Circular Bronze Age shield with 7 peripheral/central boss studs. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_071 and Linear A AB77. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/ka/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 12): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Round Shield) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/ka/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
